nodes.title: 01 · Story and book controls
2 · Create character, prop, location and scale references

widgets_values:
Leave the premise blank for a new idea, or enter your own. Choose the age range, page count and art style, then click Run.

Local Gemma writes and reviews the story. The workflow generates character, prop and location references, then creates the cover and every page with Flux2 Turbo 8, reviews and retries the art, and exports the book.

Revision 2.12: The review draft shows the generation method, model and saved sampling settings for each attempt. Local retries can remove an isolated duplicate character or prop. Extra props are inventoried with their contents; removal must preserve the original object and existing character interaction. Failed or uncertain edits fall back within the saved attempt budget.
nodes.title: CHILDREN’S BOOK GENERATOR · V2.7 PREVIEW

widgets_values:
Randomize creates a new book. To resume, load the original job from History, restore its seed and set seed control to fixed. Completed stages and candidate images are reused with matching checks.

Output: ComfyUI/output/books/. Read book.html when complete, or review-draft.html to inspect ongoing/failed work and all saved attempts.

book_builder.notes: All originals preserved. Requires the local comfyui-book-builder node pack.

book_builder_preview.validation: Earlier fresh renders after ineffective edits; controller tests pass. Whole-book quality and user acceptance remain pending.

extra.duplicate_repair_note: One local removal may preserve a useful composition; the planner compares gaze/contact/story roles and an independent before/after gate can veto an edit. References and edits retain 28 steps; fresh scenes use Turbo8.

book_builder_revision.changes: Visible per-image method and model; bounded local extra-object removal with original contents and interactions preserved. Individual prop/location reference inputs when they fit the six-image budget.
